items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I worked with Dave Martholomeo at... 48... 47 and 48, I think.

ctx.x: Have you traveled around the country very much?

Or... Well, uh... I'm 51. Right after... Right after... recording around town... No, I think it was right after... After I came from California. Because I was living in this house. I worked with Dave Martholomeo at... 48... 47 and 48, I think. Mm-hmm.
